name: haichi-engine
description: A tiny pure-geometry layout engine for 2D and 3D — packing, hierarchy, treemap, city blocks, relaxation — plus a measurable quality report (overlap, label fit, legible font, crossings, occlusion, walkability). Decides WHERE things go, never draws them. Feeds zumen / game-engine-suite. Dependency-free, deterministic, headless-testable.

scripts.test: node test.mjs && node test3d.mjs && node integration/zumen-layout.test.mjs && node integration/game-board.test.mjs
